## Regional Fire-Use Research Map

This map shows the communities and places associated with the northern Alberta fire-use research alongside rivers, lakes, terrain, present-day reserve boundaries, and Wood Buffalo National Park. Point symbols distinguish primary ethnographic source locations from places included for broader geographic context.

[![](images/maps/regional-fire-map.png){.static-preview .map-preview fig-alt="Regional map showing locations and geographic context associated with the northern Alberta Indigenous fire-use research"}](images/maps/regional-fire-map.png){target="_blank"}

::: {.map-credit}

**CRS:** NAD83(CSRS) / Alberta 10-TM (Forest) (EPSG:3402).

**Sources:** [Government of Alberta / Alberta Data Partnerships Ltd.](https://app.geo.ca/en-ca/map-browser/record/79671bf3-706a-47df-9ebd-d4789ce957e8) (reserve boundaries); [Parks Canada](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nt/woodbuffalo/visit/brochures) (Wood Buffalo National Park boundary); [Natural Resources Canada, Canada3D](https://app.geo.ca/en-ca/map-browser/record/042f4628-94b2-40ac-9bc1-ca3ac2a27d82) (elevation and derived hillshade); [© OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) (Alberta boundary, rivers, and lakes), ODbL. Source and contextual locations compiled by Matthew Walls primarily from project source literature. Cartography by Nicholas Giardina.

:::

::: {.portfolio-actions}

[Open full-size map](images/maps/regional-fire-map.png){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

[Download credited PDF](files/maps/regional-fire-map-credited.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-secondary target="_blank"}

:::

**My role:** I created this map in QGIS using location data compiled by Dr. Matthew Walls and existing boundary, waterway, and elevation datasets. I organized and styled the layers, adjusted labels and the legend, and prepared the print layout for PNG and PDF export.

**Skills demonstrated:** QGIS, coordinate reference systems, vector and raster data integration, symbology, labeling, and print layout design.

## Meander River Close-Up Map

This map provides a closer view of Meander River, one of the dataset's primary ethnographic source locations. Satellite imagery shows the surrounding landscape alongside the reserve boundary and the courses of the Hay and Meander rivers.

[![](images/maps/meander-river-close-up-map.png){.static-preview .map-preview fig-alt="Close-up map of Meander River and its surrounding geographic context"}](images/maps/meander-river-close-up-map.png){target="_blank"}

::: {.map-credit}

**CRS:** NAD83(CSRS) / Alberta 10-TM (Forest) (EPSG:3402).

**Sources:** [Government of Alberta / Alberta Data Partnerships Ltd.](https://app.geo.ca/en-ca/map-browser/record/79671bf3-706a-47df-9ebd-d4789ce957e8) (reserve boundary); [© OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright) (rivers), ODbL. Imagery: [Esri World Imagery](https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=974d45be315c4c87b2ac32be59af9a0b), Vantor WorldView-3 (WV03), acquired 17 June 2025. Source and contextual locations compiled by Matthew Walls primarily from project source literature. Cartography by Nicholas Giardina.

:::

::: {.portfolio-actions}

[Open full-size map](images/maps/meander-river-close-up-map.png){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

[Download credited PDF](files/maps/meander-river-close-up-map-credited.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-secondary target="_blank"}

:::

**My role:** I designed this map in QGIS by combining satellite imagery with reserve boundary, river, and location layers. I adjusted the map extent, layer styling, labels, and legend for the local view and prepared the print layout for PNG and PDF export.

**Skills demonstrated:** QGIS, integration of imagery and vector data, map symbology, label placement, and print layout design.

## Greenland Archaeological Feature Mapping

I created these maps in QGIS by digitizing archaeological houses and tent rings from supplied aerial imagery.

### Qassisalik: Houses and Tent Rings

This map shows the locations and outlines of houses and tent rings at Qassisalik. Labels identify the individual features, while the aerial imagery provides their surrounding site context.

[![](images/maps/qassisalik-portfolio.png){.static-preview .map-preview fig-alt="Site-scale map showing digitized house and tent-ring features at Qassisalik, Greenland"}](images/maps/qassisalik-portfolio.png){target="_blank"}

::: {.map-credit}

**CRS:** WGS 84 / UTM zone 19N (EPSG:32619).

**Source:** Aerial imagery supplied by Dr. Matthew Walls. Archaeological feature polygons and cartography by Nicholas Giardina.

:::

::: {.portfolio-actions}

[Open full-size map](images/maps/qassisalik-portfolio.png){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

[Download PDF](images/maps/qassisalik-portfolio.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-secondary target="_blank"}

:::

### Pitoraavik Houses

This map shows five house features at Pitoraavik. The digitized polygons are overlaid on the aerial imagery so that the mapped outlines and visible structural remains can be viewed together.

[![](images/maps/pitoraavik-portfolio.png){.static-preview .map-preview fig-alt="Close-up map showing five digitized house features at Pitoraavik, Greenland"}](images/maps/pitoraavik-portfolio.png){target="_blank"}

::: {.map-credit}

**CRS:** WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

**Source:** Aerial imagery supplied by Dr. Matthew Walls. Archaeological feature polygons and cartography by Nicholas Giardina.

:::

::: {.portfolio-actions}

[Open full-size map](images/maps/pitoraavik-portfolio.png){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

[Download PDF](images/maps/pitoraavik-portfolio.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-secondary target="_blank"}

:::

**My role:** I created the archaeological feature polygons in QGIS by tracing houses and tent rings from supplied aerial imagery. I organized and labeled the features, selected symbology that remained visible against the imagery, and designed and exported the Qassisalik and Pitoraavik map layouts.

**Skills demonstrated:** QGIS, interpretation of aerial imagery, polygon digitization, vector attribute management, feature labeling, symbology, cartographic design, and print-layout preparation.
